meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 能处理系统发育树或层次树，支持树文件读写、拓扑编辑、距离比较、进化事件检测、NCBI 分类注释及图形输出等。
howto.when: 当用户要求读写 Newick/Nexus 树、编辑树拓扑或比较/可视化树等时触发；不用于从原始序列推断树。

say.text: 比较这两棵树的 Robinson-Foulds 拓扑距离
say.note: 计算 RF 距离并报告差异。

say.text: 用 NCBI 分类库给基因树叶子加谱系并导出 SVG

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to work with phylogenetic or hierarchical trees, including tree file I/O, topology editing, distance comparison, evolutionary event detection, NCBI taxonomy annotation, and figure output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read/write Newick/Nexus trees, edit tree topology, or compare/visualize trees, etc.; not for inferring trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Read tree.nw and show leaf and total node counts.
say_en.note: Uses ETE to summarize the tree.

say_en.text: Compare the Robinson-Foulds distance between these two trees.
say_en.note: Reports RF distance and shared leaves.

say_en.text: Annotate this gene tree with NCBI taxonomy and export SVG.
